job: Turn a research topic or supplied corpus into a source-grounded, auditable deep-research package instead of a four-prompt role-play transcript.
real_inputs: A research topic or decision question
User-supplied articles, papers, URLs, notes, or a closed corpus
Audience, geography, timeframe, freshness, and output constraints
primary_output: A validated research package with a canonical Markdown report, provenance-bearing source and Claim-Evidence ledgers, contradiction and uncertainty records, consistent HTML and PDF, and machine-readable validation evidence.
description: Use STORM-inspired perspectives to generate retrieval questions, ground every material claim in provenance-bearing evidence, refuse unsupported completion, and deliver validated Markdown, HTML, and PDF research artifacts.
exclusions: Personalized medical, legal, or investment advice
constraints: Perspectives may generate questions but may not authorize facts
Bundled scripts may not initiate undeclared network access
Credentials must remain in environment variables
Full mode requires PDF and all failed gates must exit non-zero
Public artifacts may not expose local paths, credentials, or internal audit IDs
standards: Explicit fact, inference, recommendation, contradiction, and uncertainty labeling
One canonical Markdown source with cross-format consistency
Adversarial evaluation, baseline comparison, trust checks, and install simulation
correction: Do not expand the prompt chain as the main solution; move authority into retrieval adapters, source and claim ledgers, strict validators, and release governance.
user_references: The Stanford STORM Method article supplied by the user
